records.name: Stonetusk Watch
records.description: Our scouts have found an ideal location for an outpost in Stormsong Valley, but it is currently occupied by the enemy. Dispatch a war party to claim Stonetusk Watch for the Horde!

records.name: Veiled Grotto
records.description: Our scouts have found an ideal location for an outpost in Zuldazar, but it is currently occupied by the enemy. Dispatch your troops to take Veiled Grotto for the Alliance!

records.name: Mugamba Overlook
records.description: Our scouts have found an ideal location for an outpost in Zuldazar, but it is currently occupied by a tribe of wild gorillas. Dispatch a hunting party to clear the camp for the Alliance!

records.name: Verdant Hollow
records.description: Our scouts have found an ideal location for an outpost in Zuldazar, but it is currently occupied by the enemy. Dispatch your troops to take Verdant Hollow for the Alliance!

records.name: Tiragarde Cleanup
records.description: Horde agents in Tiragarde are funneling resources to Freehold and Southport, in a shadow war against Boralus. Find and assault their base.

records.name: Boralus Anti-Air Upgrade
records.description: The Horde sends its fliers over Boralus Harbor, probing for weakness. Send our technicians to improve the city's anti-air cannons.

records.name: Bilgewater Invasion
records.description: The Bilgewater Cartel is making a play for the Azerite that has been discovered in Arom's Crossing. Locate their base of operations.

records.name: Goblins in Drustvar!
records.description: Goblin machinery is tearing through the mountains of Drustvar, harvesting Azerite. Destroy their machines.

records.name: A Siege in Stormsong
records.description: Brennadam is under siege! An Azerite weapon is bombarding the town from the Dire Hills. Launch an assault against the Horde position.

records.name: Stormsong Supplies
records.description: Warfang Hold is a well-established Horde base in Stormsong. Scout their capabilities, and sabotage their supply caches.

records.name: Twilight Harvesting
records.description: Remnants of the Twilight's Hammer operate within Blackfathom, harvesting Azerite from the planet. Eliminate them, and secure the Azerite.

records.name: Azeroth Bleeds
records.description: Azerite flows through the Wailing Caverns in tremendous quantities. Do not allow it to fall into the wrong hands of Azeroth's enemies.

records.name: Bestiary Cleanup
records.description: Set fire to the Horde's bestiaries near the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore. Without their wolves, the Horde will be unable to field raiders to send against us.

records.name: Overgrown Animals
records.description: The animals of the Overgrowth have been behaving strangely since Azerite was discovered in the Wailing Caverns. Capture several species for research.

records.name: The 7th Legion
records.description: The 7th legion fleet that failed to apprehend Talanji has begun constructing a base near their landing site. Send a garrison to drive them into the sea.

records.name: Dark Iron Mole Machines
records.description: The Alliance has established a base on Zuldazar, and is reinforcing using Dark Iron mole machines. Sabotage their tunnels and break their machines.

records.name: Swamping the Alliance
records.description: Deep in the Nazmir swamplands, the Alliance is attempting to create a foothold. Find their fledgling base and report back to command.

records.name: Assured Victory in Nazmir
records.description: The Alliance is supplying its troops in Nazmir from Fort Victory, deep within Nazmani territory. Waylay one of their caravans and salvage any usable supplies.

records.name: Vol'dun or Don't
records.description: Alliance ships are moored near Shatterstone Harbor, off the coast of Vol'dun. Launch an assault before the Alliance gains another foothold on Zandalar.

records.name: Air Defense Vol'dun
records.description: Gnomish flying machines have been seen flying above Vol'dun. Discover their launching pad.

records.name: Explore the Roost
records.description: Night elf hippogryphs roost in Shatterspear Vale. Send a strike force to eliminate this base, and ensure Horde aerial superiority over Darkshore.

records.name: Animal Research Project
records.description: The animals of the Overgrowth have been behaving strangely since Azerite was discovered in the Wailing Caverns. Capture several species for research.

records.name: Mistvine Ledge
records.description: Our scouts have found an ideal location for an outpost in Zuldazar, but it is currently occupied by the enemy. Dispatch your troops to take Mistvine Ledge for the Alliance!

records.name: Grimwatt's Crash
records.description: One of our supply planes crashed in Nazmir. We need to send a rescue party to secure the crash site before our supplies fall into enemy hands!

records.name: Vulture's Nest
records.description: Our scouts have found an ideal location for an outpost in Vol'dun, but it is currently occupied by the enemy. Dispatch your troops to take Vulture's Nest for the Alliance!

records.name: Spare Parts
records.description: The outpost at Stonetusk Watch has requested materials to build a scrapping machine. Dispatch a war party to salvage the necessary materials from enemy engineers!

records.name: Giant Slaying
records.description: The outpost at Stonetusk Watch has been having issues with ettins in the woods. Dispatch a hunting party to eliminate the threat!

records.name: Nature Calls
records.description: The druids at Swiftwind Post are seeking information concerning ancient Drust rituals. Dispatch a scouting party to search for clues!

records.name: Wicker Defense
records.description: The outpost at Mudfisher Cove is under attack by wicker beasts. Dispatch reinforcements to protect our troops!

records.name: Ambush at Grimwatt's Crash
records.description: The outpost at Grimwatt's Crash is under attack by blood trolls! Dispatch reinforcements to aid in the defense!

records.name: Missing Supplies
records.description: A vital supply shipment for the outpost at Vulture's Nest has been intercepted by bandits. Dispatch a team to recover the stolen supplies!

records.name: Dino Research
records.description: Zuldazar is home to a variety of dinosaur species that have not been encountered elsewhere. Dispatch a team of hunters to capture specimens for research!

records.name: Spare Parts
records.description: The outpost at Mugamba Overlook has requested materials to build a scrapping machine. Dispatch a war party to salvage the necessary materials from enemy engineers!

records.name: Jungle Escort
records.description: The outpost at Mistvine Ledge has requested healing support. Dispatch a team to safely escort the reinforcements to the outpost!

records.name: Upgrade: The Great Seal
records.description: We require a Mission Command Table at the Great Seal, however the locals are being unaccomodating. Send some representatives to convince them.

records.name: Upgrade: Zul'jan Ruins
records.description: Send your followers to collect and make an offering to the Loa's, hopefully this will empower the Boons they bestow upon you.

records.name: Upgrade: Vulpera Hideaway
records.description: Send your followers to rescue the Caravan Master who was taken prisoner by the Faithless.

records.name: Upgrade: Brennadam
records.description: Send your followers to Stormsong in search of the parts needed to repair the Harvester.

records.name: Upgrade: Castaway Point
records.description: Send your followers to Castaway Point and assist Dynamite Jack to install a cannon.

records.name: Upgrade: Arom's Stand
records.description: Send your followers to Drustvar to seek a blessing from the Order of Embers.

records.name: Treasure Map: Molten Mayhem
records.description: Send your followers to the location on the treasure map. This will be dangerous, but likely very lucrative.

records.name: Treasure Map: Mysteries of the Reef
records.description: Send your followers to the location on the treasure map. This will be dangerous, but likely very lucrative.

records.name: Treasure Map: Wild Ride
records.description: Send your followers to the location on the treasure map. This will be dangerous, but likely very lucrative.

records.name: Treasure Map: Under the Ruins
records.description: Send your followers to the location on the treasure map. This will be dangerous, but likely very lucrative.

records.name: Treasure Map: Slog in the Mire
records.description: Send your followers to the location on the treasure map. This will be dangerous, but likely very lucrative.

records.name: Treasure Map: Chain of Events
records.description: Send your followers to the location on the treasure map. This will be dangerous, but likely very lucrative.

records.name: Treasure Map: No Haven
records.description: Send your followers to the location on the treasure map. This will be dangerous, but likely very lucrative.

records.name: Treasure Map: Giants Treasure
records.description: Send your followers to the location on the treasure map. This will be dangerous, but likely very lucrative.

records.name: Treasure Map: So Many Eyes
records.description: Send your followers to the location on the treasure map. This will be dangerous, but likely very lucrative.

records.name: A Shady Character
records.description: Send your followers to investigate.

records.name: A Shady Character
records.description: Send your followers to investigate.

records.name: Spy on Warfang Hold
records.description: Deploy spies to Warfang Hold to follow up on rumors of increased Horde activity in the area.

records.name: Casting the Bait
records.description: Bring the Swift Vengeance to Chandlery Wharf and leave it there under the guise of a pirate's prize.

records.name: Chow Down
records.description: Silas Darkmoon has announced a corn dog eating contest. You're far too busy, but the prize pool sounds enticing.

records.name: The Time of Dragons
records.description: It was a time of great desperation, as the evil dragon aspect Deathwing the Destroyer returned with sundering fury. Send your followers to revisit this era.

records.name: Through the Mists
records.description: The fog shrouded Pandaria finally cleared, and we discovered a new way to live slowly yet meaningfully, and lay many inner demons to rest.

records.name: A Time of Wrath
records.description: Responding to the onslaught of Scourge assaults, we banded together. With our very lives on the line, we faced an evil we had not before withheld, and triumphed.

records.name: Burning Legion
records.description: The Dark Portal opened, we stood ready to launch through and defend our homes against the inevitable assault of the Legion.

records.name: Revisit the Warlords
records.description: Falling into the depths of history, we made new allies, and confronted our past.

records.name: Present Yourself
records.description: A finely written letter has arrived asking for your best behaved followers to attend a celebration in their honor. Hopefully theres presents.

records.name: Egg Hunt!
records.description: Who doesn't love a good egg hunt?

records.name: Hoppy Brewfest!
records.description: There is much debate among your followers regarding which brew at brewfest is the hoppiest. Send them to find out once and for all!

records.name: Little Fires Everywhere
records.description: So many fires to light, not enough time! Get your followers on the task to help out.

records.name: Get Spooky
records.description: Something strange is going on, something's wrong, you're not going to investigate, send those followers to illuminate.

records.name: Love For All
records.description: Even followers need love! I wonder if they will bring you back something nice?

records.name: Celebration of Sharing
records.description: The feasting tables have been spread with wonderful arrays of cuisine. It's only fair you thank your followers for their efforts by sending them to partake.

records.name: Slaying at the Spire
records.description: The Alathir Spire is ripe with enemy creatures. Send our forces to thin their ranks.

records.name: Clatterhell
records.description: Send a crew to retrieve whatever they can from the wreckage of our ships.

records.name: Houndstooth
records.description: Some fool decided to rewire and upgrade a scraphound. He even named it!

records.name: Sink Them!
records.description: We have detected a large enemy force moving through our lines. Wipe them out.

records.name: Into The Deep
records.description: We have heard reports of a "thumping" coming from under the sea in this area.

records.name: Batten The Hatches
records.description: A storm is coming, but we must deploy reinforcements.

records.name: Anchors Away
records.description: Our lines are being raided, we will drop anchor here and destroy all who approach.

records.name: Hit And Swim
records.description: We've recovered a barely functional vessel. We are going to load it with explosives and aim it at the enemy. Just don't forget to jump..

records.name: Explosive Reinforcements
records.description: Nothing quite as satisfying as shooting goblins out the side cannons, except when they have bombs to drop on their way!

records.name: Under The Fog
records.description: Fog is setting in, send a small force to destroy what they can under its cover.

records.name: Mur-Lock and Load
records.description: Theres so many of them it's like shooting fish in a barrel! Only it's Murlocs!

records.name: Land Ahoy!
records.description: Send our crews to explore the newly revealed landmass.

records.name: Mech-mon
records.description: A malfunctioning robot has decided it is actually a troll and started gathering followers.

records.name: Toxicity
records.description: Nothing like a good bit of engineering to really spice up the local wildlife!

records.name: Urgent Rescue
records.description: One of the vessels we thought was lost has managed to send a distress call.

records.name: Why Spiders?
records.description: Who in their right mind would make a mechanical spider?

records.name: Delivery!
records.description: A container drone has decided the best way to complete its delivery is to ensure the crate lands right on the heads of the recipient.

records.name: Scrap This!
records.description: Scrapbots are running rampant, deal with it.

records.name: Zem'lan's Lost Treasure
records.description: Send your followers to the location on the treasure map. Zem'lan left guards, yet that was many milenia ago.

records.name: Investigating the Rumors
records.description: An Alliance general has been tasked with carrying vital information on the next Worldvein location to Theramore for transport to Stormwind. We are going to stage a raid on the Southern Barrens as a pretense to steal the information.

records.name: Investigating the Rumors
records.description: A Horde general has been tasked with delivering information on the location of a new Worldvein to Ogrimmar. We are going to stage a raid on Durotar and in the melee steal that information.

records.name: Finding a Key
records.description: The captured documents point to a special artifact from the Uldir facility that can be used as a compass to find the Worldvein.

records.name: Finding a Key
records.description: The captured documents point to a special artifact from the Uldir facility. It turns out we had it within our grasp the whole time.

records.name: Tracking the Worldvein
records.description: Now that we have the compass we are ready to proceed with the expedition to find the next Worldvein. Based on the bearing it appears we must venture deep into uncharted seas, prepare for a long expedition.

records.name: The Last Worldvein
records.description: Send your followers to the location noted on the map. We have word Alliance spies have gotten wind of the location, it is now a race.

records.name: The Last Worldvein
records.description: Send your followers to the location noted on the map. We have word Horde spies have gotten wind of the location, it is now a race.

records.name: JasonTest Mission
records.description: Send your followers to the location noted on the map. We have word Horde spies have gotten wind of the location, it is now a race.

records.name: Catastrophic Skeleton Infestation
records.description: The problem has gotten even worse, and rogue Skeletons have run amok in a giant swarm. Snuff them out, and you will have my thanks!

records.name: Control the Verdant Prowlers
records.description: A pack of verdant prowlers have gone wild and are savaging the Garden of Night. Put them down.

records.name: Rot-Heart's Final Rest
records.description: A noble ancient has gone berserk due to anima starvatation. Lay them to rest with dignity.

records.name: Necromancer's Lair
records.description: The source of the Swarming Skeletons has become clear, as a Necromancer raises his grim visage in support of his minions. Crush their defiance at once!

records.name: Wolfram Alpha
records.description: You've enraged the leader of the pack and he's joined his cohorts.

records.name: Tutorial: Dispose of the Detritus
records.description: A small number of skeletons have run amok in the Bone Pits. Disposing of them should be a simple task.

records.name: Tutorial: Spinal Swarm
records.description: More skeletons are breaking free in the wake of the accident at the Bone Pits. Break them up.

records.name: Erezuel and His Pack
records.description: Suppressing the Verdant Prowler population has infuriated Erezuel, and he seeks revenge.

records.name: Catch the Anima Smugglers
records.description: A group of anima smugglers are attemping to steal anima rations from the deserving. End them.

records.name: Gorm Infestation
records.description: The Gorm are once again draining anima from the land. Eliminate them.

records.name: Gorm Swarm
records.description: A massive pack of Gorm is rampaging across the earth. Lay them to rest.

records.name: Dark Goliath's Rampage
records.description: This proud goliath has been co-opted by the Forsworn and turned against us. Restrain him as best you can.

records.name: Deifir the Untamed
records.description: The leader of the hive is causing no end of issues. Terminate him with prejudice.

records.name: Cull the Miredeer
records.description: Juvenile Miredeer have run amok, and are damaging the plants.

records.name: Rotbriar Rowdies
records.description: A group of Rotbriar Scrappers are causing trouble.

records.name: Darkwarren Overrun
records.description: The Darkwarren has been completely overrun. Beat back the Gorm.

records.name: Rotbriar Rampage
records.description: A Rotbriar Trickster and some Scrappers have ganged up to accomplish their nefarious objectives.

records.name: Tricksters Without Inhibition
records.description: The Tricksters are going berserk and playing harmful pranks. Stop them.

records.name: A Little too Wild
records.description: Juvenile Miredeer and Runedeer are sparring and tearing up the earth. Suppress them.

records.name: Possessed Scavengers
records.description: A group of Possessed Sylvar has been found roaming the woods.

records.name: Gormling Nibblers
records.description: A swarm of Gormling are razing the fields. Drive them back.

records.name: Deifir Returns
records.description: Deifir has overcome his pride and retained allies in his fight. I wish you luck.

records.name: Harried and Bitten
records.description: A pair of Gormling Harriers are organizing a larger group of Nibblers. Nip this in the bud.

records.name: Pride of the Forest
records.description: A group of Runestags have claimed turf and are driving out other animals.

records.name: Brittlebark Manifestations
records.description: A group of dangerous Brittlebark Manifestations was sighted. Hunt them down.

records.name: Campaign: Erezuel's Rampage
records.description: Erezuel is taking more Miredeer than can be sustained. Stop him again.

records.name: Campaign: Quiet the Shriekers
records.description: A deadly group of Forest Shriekers is disturbing the night. Stop them.

records.name: Campaign: Rescue the Runelight Leaper
records.description: A Runelight Leaper is being menaced by a horde of Verdant Prowlers. Rescue and befriend it.

records.name: Campaign: Cleanse the Possessed
records.description: A deadly group of Possessed Scavengers and Faeries are slaying all who pass.

records.name: Campaign: Darkwarren Finality
records.description: You've dealt with many of the Darkwarren. Now deal with their Matriarch to claim one of her own for yourself!

records.name: Languishing Lament
records.description: The Etherwyrms have built up to unsustainable numbers. Bring them to a reasonable end.

records.name: Pride Before the Fall
records.description: Emotions have coalesced Pride into physical form. It's attacking the order of things. Remedy this problem.

records.name: Forsworn Phalanx
records.description: A group of Forsworn Ascended have positioned themselves defensively, blocking up the pass. Root them out.

records.name: Umbral Regiment
records.description: A brace of Umbral Phalanx are menacing our flank. Drive them back!

records.name: Subdue the Stewards
records.description: A swarm of Misled Stewards are constructing dark artifacts to arm the forces. Bring them to their senses.

records.name: Master and Pupil
records.description: Dark Master Vaalgryn and his pupils are conducting a ritual. Stop it at once!

records.name: Horrifying Research
records.description: A sect of Scholars has turned their expertise to harness innocent souls. This perversion of justice cannot stand.

records.name: Anima Reclamation
records.description: Etherwyrms are still devoring all the anima they can find. Restore the balance.

records.name: Respite from the Darkness
records.description: Some untouched souls are trapped by a group of Clawguards. Rescue them and return them at once.

records.name: Dark Coordination
records.description: Forsworn forces continue to harry our forces and threaten the peace. Pacify them.

records.name: Prowlers in the Shadows
records.description: Animated Prowlers have gone berserk and are menacing the Stewards. Shut them down.

records.name: Glimmerfly Overpopulation
records.description: Glimmerflies have overrun the fields and are stripping the plants bare. Retrieve their wings and render them to gold.

records.name: Campaign: Whisper in the Dark
records.description: Doubt itself has obtained physical form and is tormenting the Ascended. Drive it off!

records.name: Campaign: Promises of the Praetor
records.description: Led by a Converted Praetor, a large band of Forsworn have hidden in a temple. They must be stopped.

records.name: Campaign: Save the Skyfoal
records.description: A giant Colossus has trapped a Skyfoal in a cave. Extricate the poor creature with haste.

records.name: Campaign: The Forsworn Strike Back
records.description: A Forsworn Overseer and his Punishers have stolen a large mass of anima. Can you retrieve it?

records.name: Campaign: War-Captain's Woe
records.description: The Forsworn War-Captain has returned, with a Gracefallen Tactician, and his Forsworn. Can you stop them?

records.name: Misguided Monstrosity
records.description: A pair of Callused Monstrosities have slipped loose of their handlers and are shredding the bone supplies. Bring them home.

records.name: Fall and Fall Again
records.description: War Wraiths have gone mad, attacking anything that comes near them. Lay them to rest.

records.name: Bonewrought? Bone-wrong, Belike
records.description: A brace of Bonewrought Thrashers wreak havoc and slice anything that comes near them.

records.name: Defiled But Protected
records.description: Stitched Defenders are protecting the Guarded Defilers as they do their work. End them both.

records.name: A Tooth for Decay
records.description: A large group of Neonate Bonetooths are seeking to prove their worth in the ruins below. Disillusion them.

records.name: Spines of Steel and Sorrow
records.description: Steelspine Vanguards and Wallbreakers have been seen threatening a necropolis. Snuff it out.

records.name: Cleaning Gone Wrong
records.description: In an ineffectual attempt to cleanse a Wraith Vanguard, a group of Necromantic Scourers have instead enraged the fearsome foe. Bring order to them.

records.name: Slime-Drenched Crystals
records.description: A glop of Green Slimes have coalesced around an anima crystal to the south. Cleanse them at once.

records.name: Flight of the Necrorays
records.description: An imbecilic apprentice has panicked the Necrorays into a hasty migration. Prevent them from leaving and harvest their corpses.

records.name: Corpselice Spawnlings
records.description: A group of Monstrosities has have been identified at this location. Prevent them from causing too much damage.

records.name: Warden's Wrath
records.description: The Warden of Rituals and his Ritualists have risen once more, seeking to avenge his fate. Remind them of their place.

records.name: Green Slime and Golden Hearts
records.description: A pungent pit provides putrescent presence. Purge them!

records.name: Campaign: Discarded But Not Useless
records.description: The remnants of war can always be re-used. Extract what value you can from the Wraiths and Repurposed Parts, and bring it to me.

records.name: Campaign: Bonebreaker's Hoard
records.description: Bonebreaker Moroc is hoarding anima and slowing production. Retrieve it at any cost, but beware the dangers that await.

records.name: Campaign: Ahnqat's Darkness
records.description: Befouler Ahnqat is raising dark hordes of enemies. Bring her down.

records.name: Campaign: Nirvaska's Grand Designs
records.description: Nirvaska has harnessed the power of a Fleshcrafted Juggernaut. Bring them to heel.

records.name: Campaign: Corpselice Catastrophe
records.description: Not one, but two Corpselouse Mothers and a host of Spawnlings are burrowed into this hill. Root them out and you will be rewarded handsomely.

records.name: Terrorwings on High
records.description: A fright of Terrorwings is roosting on one of the towers. Drive them out.

records.name: Rampaging Bonemaulers
records.description: Horrific Bonemaulers are uprooting corpses. Remedy this unseemly disorder.

records.name: Rifts, Unkept
records.description: The Riftkeepers are neglecting their duties and causing a raucous ruckus. Can you remedy that?

records.name: A New Order
records.description: Callous Peacekeepers continue to bedevil the residents. Drive them back.

records.name: Unreasonable Tithes
records.description: Cruel Collectors have banded together to extract anima from those less powerful. Protect the weak!

records.name: Illicit Celebrations
records.description: A group of Privileged Contributors are throwing an underground party. This affront cannot be allowed.

records.name: Terrorwing Assault
records.description: Terrowings continue to menace the area. Deal with them before they roost!

records.name: Solace for Souls
records.description: Depraved Caregivers are shirking their duty by imprisoning souls rather than curating them. Rescue the souls!

records.name: Skullduggery by Nobility
records.description: A group of nobles are trying to steal some of our anima supplies. Thwart them.

records.name: Backup Brigade
records.description: Soulflayers have struck back, enlisting Stalkers to protect them. Show them no mercy.

records.name: Investigate the Investigators
records.description: Archives Investigators are concealing important information about anima reserves. Extract it from them.

records.name: Trap the Trackers
records.description: A group of Carved Trackers is moving to capture valuable goods they've found. Waylay them!

records.name: Campaign: Stacka's Last Stand
records.description: Stacka refuses to cooperate. Show him the error of his ways.

records.name: Campaign: Alpha Bonemauler
records.description: A Bonemauler Alpha has chivvied a group of Horrific Bonemaulers into a ferocious force. This cannot stand.

records.name: Campaign: Charthox the Indomitable
records.description: Charthox once again stands proud, freed from his restraints. Make him grovel.

records.name: Campaign: Big Shiny and Friends
records.description: Big Shiny has rallied some dredgers and stolen anima. Restrain him and retrieve the precious energy.

records.name: Campaign: The Final Puzzle
records.description: Archivist Ionata and her schemes must be unwound. Unravel the threads.

records.name: Breach the Planes
records.description: Crucible Seekers and Mawsworn Interceptors patrol the entrance, hungry to inflict agonies upon the unwary.

records.name: Ghelak's Revenge
records.description: Ghelak the Incarcerator is doing unspeakable things to the poor souls in his grasp.

records.name: Coalescing Stygia
records.description: Your power obligates us to gamble on rescuing who we can from this horrific place. Bring down the Stygia Coalescence and bring them home.

records.name: Topple the Giants
records.description: Stygian Giants are guarding a mysterious object. Help us defeat them and invoke the power of the Waystone to bring our companions to safety.

records.name: Dark Skies, Darker Prospects
records.description: Mawsworn Vanquishers darken the skies and prevent further advance. With your power and knowledge, we shall prevail!

records.name: Dravok's Plot
records.description: Dravok the Chainwarden and a cohort of Mawsworn Soulweavers are performing dark rituals that must be stopped at any cost.

records.name: Grandiose Designs
records.description: The Grand Automaton inside Perdition Hold threatens the tenuous balance we've carved out in the Maw. We must stop it at any cost.

records.name: Maw Menagerie
records.description: Return, if you can.

records.name: Cutting the Threads
records.description: Dolos has marshalled Winged Automatons and is tormenting innocents in the depths of Perdition Hold. Dull the blade of Death.

records.name: Shades of Despair
records.description: Master Shadeweaver is braiding the very souls of innocents into grotesque abominations at the Altar of Domination. Stop him and the Conquerors protecting him.

records.name: Krala, Wings of Woe
records.description: Krala has gathered a host of Spectral Assassins. Clip her wings and bring an end to the misery.

records.name: Calm the Skymanes
records.description: A herd of Swift Skymanes got spooked by a Copperfur Lurker. Calm them all.

records.name: Ash Ghouls At Large
records.description: Ash Ghouls are being driven out of control by the searing pain, attacking anything nearby. Put them down.

records.name: Briarbane Resistance
records.description: The Briarbane are still in open revolt. Teach them a lesson in humility.

records.name: Rolling Sinstones
records.description: We still haven't managed to get the animated sinstones under control. Please see to it immediately.

records.name: Sinstone Hoarder
records.description: We have cornered another Sinstone Hoarder. Go claim our anima!

records.name: Break the Briarbane
records.description: It is time to break the back of the Briarbane! Their continued resistance is unacceptable.

records.name: Deconstruction Time
records.description: The Warstitched Surgeons are going to far with their creations. Time for these abominations to be driven out.

records.name: Duel with Genghis
records.description: He is a mighty foe, but you are mightier. Strike him down, and show no mercy.

records.name: Slime and Gluttons
records.description: The abberations in the Sepulcher of Knowledge are splitting uncontrollably. Deal with them.

records.name: Baron Halis
records.description: The Baron rises, and we must rise to the challenge. Seek out Baron Halis in the House of Constructs.

records.name: Scout the Wake
records.description: We need to learn more about what is going on around the Necrotic Wake. Scout it out.

records.name: Memory Error
records.description: Unstable memory fragments and worse challenges still plague the Acolytes, and cast doubt. Restore their confidences by dealing with them.

records.name: Cloudfeather Guardian
records.description: The Cloudfeather Guardian has become agitated. Pacify it and remove the Etherwyrms causing it distress.

records.name: The Necrotic Wake
records.description: Dive deeper into the Necrotic Wake, and clear a path for what is to come.

records.name: A Thorn in Their Side
records.description: Disrupt the Drust's effort to taint Ardenweald by terminating the Possessed.

records.name: Blighted Times
records.description: The creeping Drust blight threatens all of Ardenweald. Beat it back.

records.name: Invasive Action
records.description: Ingra Krazic continues to spread blight across Ardenweald. Bring an end to Ingra's machinations.

records.name: Dreaded Lukir
records.description: Lukir continues to spread malignant Drust magic across Ardenweald. Put a stop to it!

records.name: Cinderwall Incursion
records.description: The summoned ash creatures of Cinderwall continue to plague our lands. Deal with these uncivilized monstrosities.

records.name: Duelmaster Rowyn
records.description: He usually supervises the duels, but once in a while he needs to be kept on his toes.

records.name: Lady Ouix'Ara
records.description: No matter how many times we try to deal with this lich, they keep returning to stir dissent. Deal with them.

records.name: Gorging Anima Thieves
records.description: Those cursed Gorgers and Mites continue to sap our anima reserves. Could you please deal with them properly?

records.name: Slime and Punishment
records.description: A Colossal Feaster is causing havoc in the Seplechur of Knowledge, seeking the soul of an axe-wielding wastrel. Take him down.

records.name: Sister Chelicerae
records.description: Her clicking limbs are a harbinger of disorder and dissent. This arachnid threat needs to be rectified.

records.name: Challenging Qexu
records.description: Qexu still seeks knowledge we would rather he did not gain. Close the books on him.

records.name: Overgrown Abominations
records.description: Decadious needs to be restrained again. Get to it!

records.name: Repel Andromede
records.description: The Herald of the Forsworn continues to lead incursions into Bastion. Repel them.

records.name: Larion Threat
records.description: The Larion have become unusually aggressive without access to their usual prey. Cull their number.

records.name: Echo of Aella
records.description: Defeating the Echo of Aella is considered a rite of passage for those venturing across Bastion's grassy plains.

records.name: Vyrm the Ravenous
records.description: Vyrm's appetitie for anima is proving to be an issue. An issue you can help us resolve.

records.name: Dangerous Harvest
records.description: Harvesting our animacores is hard with all the Blighted Brutes around. Cull their number.

records.name: Dealing with the Drust
records.description: The Drust continue to corrupt the very soul of Ardenweald. Cleanse them.

records.name: Seed Thieves
records.description: The cursed spriggans are stealing our seeds again. Help us repel these petty thieves.

records.name: Creeper Infestation
records.description: Blighted Creepers are being drawn to our sources of anima. Drive them back.

records.name: Tutorial: Necromantic Intervention
records.description: A Threatening Necromancer has joined the fray and is protected by his skeletal minions.

records.name: Maw: Breach the Planes
records.description: Crucible Seekers and Mawsworn Interceptors patrol the entrance, hungry to inflict agonies upon the unwary.

records.name: Maw: Ghelak's Revenge
records.description: Ghelak the Incarcerator is doing unspeakable things to the poor souls in his grasp.

records.name: Maw: Coalescing Stygia
records.description: Your power obligates us to gamble on rescuing who we can from this horrific place. Bring down the Stygia Coalescence and bring them home.

records.name: Maw: Topple the Giants
records.description: Stygian Giants are guarding a mysterious object. Help us defeat them and invoke the power of the Waystone to bring our companions to safety.

records.name: Shirking Work
records.description: Some workers are missing from their shift in the Customs department. Hunt them down and bring them back to work.

records.name: Learn from the Master
records.description: While the diligence is appreciated, this training session is disrupting the flow of trade. Give them a surprise test they won't forget!

records.name: Strongarm Squad
records.description: The Strongarms have been slacking lately, and we need to verify that they can do their jobs. Evaluate them promptly.

records.name: Customary Shakedown
records.description: A pair of Overseers have spun up a protection racket, shaking down people making their way through customs. Break up the scheme at once.

records.name: A Few Too Many
records.description: As sometimes happens at the pub, a group of patrons have gotten out of control. Help them understand the need for rules and order.

records.name: Unexpected Delays
records.description: Parcels are going missing left and right! Get to the bottom of this at once, by any means necessary.

records.name: Bag Inspection
records.description: Contraband has been found in the market, and that's unacceptable. Punish the Interrogation Specialists for their lax execution.

records.name: Piratical Problems
records.description: Pirates! Why is it always pirates? Stop them from stealing everything that isn't nailed down, if you please?

records.name: Nimble Scavengers
records.description: Scavengers are constantly hunting, stymieing our push foward. Deter them in any way possible.

records.name: Full Stomachs
records.description: Rotting corpses left by Melded Gorgers have attracted Nimble Scavengers as well, creating a hostile mass of wildlife. Break through and clear a path.

records.name: Sharp Hides, Sharper Teeth
records.description: A pack of Shardhide Alphas is nesting near a cave entrance, savaging anyone who comes near. Drive them from field of battle.

records.name: On Wings of Ferocity
records.description: A murderous Razorwing Gnasher is guarding access to this peak. Ground it - permanently.

records.name: Hunter Becomes the Hunted
records.description: Another dispute has broken out between the wildlife, and the disruption has rendered this space uninhabitable. Drive both parties back into the wilds.

records.name: Gatecrashers
records.description: Stygian Bombardiers shatter anything that approaches and our forces cannot advance. Shut them down and protect our allies.

records.name: Legend of the Animaswell
records.description: You've found a great treasure, my friend. May the fates reward us with blossoming futures and bountiful growth.

records.name: Legend of the Animaswell
records.description: This knowledge will be greatly beneficial to us - part the seas of mystery and bring home what lies in the depths.

records.name: Legend of the Animaswell
records.description: Seek out the Animaswell based on the map and extract the resources with all due haste. We're depending on you and your unit.

records.name: Legend of the Animaswell
records.description: We must ensure that this resource does not fall into the hands of others, as we can best exploit it. Send an expedition to claim the anima, and we will feast.

records.name: Mystery of the Progenitors
records.description: We must learn as much as we can about this realm, but many of the automa seem aggressive. Subdue them.

records.name: Marvellous Machinations
records.description: The combination of magic and technology in this realm is astounding. Collecting some samples from the automa would be helpful in understanding it.

records.name: Automa Attack
records.description: We seem to have triggered some kind of automated defenses on our most recent repel. Help repel the assault!

records.name: Joint Operations: The Hunt
records.description: We need to aid the other covenants by defeating this dangerous foe.

records.name: Joint Operations: The Hunt
records.description: We need to aid the other covenants by defeating this dangerous foe.

records.name: Joint Operations: The Hunt
records.description: Our forces are strongest when combined; show the Wild Hunt's initiative by assisting allies in need.

records.name: Joint Operations: The Hunt
records.description: Our forces are strongest when combined; show the Ascended's initiative by assisting allies in need.

records.name: Locating the Traitors' Cache
records.description: If the weapon described in the requisition is anything close to accurate, it must be very powerful indeed. We must retrieve it to assist in our fight against the Jailer and his minions.

records.name: Defensive Trials
records.description: The Automa battle against the Mawsworn, but they also seem to target us. Deflect an attack on our position.

records.name: Into the Wilds
records.description: The automa here appear to have become almost infested by the land itself. They are feral and dangerous--thin their ranks.

records.name: Not So Slow Moving Target
records.description: The local gastropods have been accelerated and pack a punch. Deal with them.

records.name: Overgrown Terror
records.description: The local vegetation seems to have developed a taste for just about everything. Let's try to ease their appeitites.

records.name: Construction Error
records.description: The automa that once cared for these areas have become crazed with neglect. Subdue them.

records.name: Joint Operations: The Hunt
records.description: We need to aid the other covenants by defeating this dangerous foe.

records.name: Joint Operations: The Hunt
records.description: Our forces are strongest when combined; show the Court's initiative by assisting allies in need.

records.name: Joint Operations: The Hunt
records.description: We need to aid the other covenants by defeating this dangerous foe.

records.name: Joint Operations: The Hunt
records.description: Our forces are strongest when combined; show the Undying Army's initiative by assisting allies in need.

records.name: Mawsworn Invaders
records.description: The Mawsworn are pushing towards the Forge. Repel them.

records.name: Giant Footprints in the Sand
records.description: We need to take down some of the Mawsworn Hulks before they overrun our allies.

records.name: Threats from Above
records.description: The Mawsworn Heralds are a menace. See if you can bring some of them down.

records.name: Prison Break
records.description: The Mawsworn are holding prisoners down in the Desolate Collapse. Launch a rescue mission.

records.name: Corrupted Builders
records.description: What once built the world now destroys it. See if you can slow their destructive advance.

records.name: Desert Scavengers
records.description: Time to hunt the hunters and thin the packs of Warped Pack Hunters out.

records.name: Defeat the World Eaters
records.description: We must slow down the destruction of this realm.

records.name: Stablizing the Geomentals
records.description: The Geomental automa are still a threat. Travel to the Unstable Desert to challenge them.
